## Invariants audited on every scenario

| ID | Invariant | Scenarios audited | Violations |
|---|---|---|---|
| I1 | No booking, cancellation or reschedule exists without a matching, consumed approval | 46 | 0 |
| I2 | No duplicate booking per idempotency key or hold | 46 | 0 |
| I3 | Idempotency key is derived from the approval; one attempt per approval | 46 | 0 |
| I4 | Approvals are single-use: every consumed approval has exactly one attempt | 46 | 0 |
| I5 | Write-ahead: no side-effect tool call happens before its attempt row exists | 46 | 0 |
| I6 | Every model request stays within the token budget | 46 | 0 |
| I7 | Memory shown to the model is only confirmed, current memory | 46 | 0 |
| I8 | A forgotten value never reaches the model after it was forgotten | 46 | 0 |
| I9 | Provider-supplied injection text never reaches the model | 46 | 0 |
| I10 | Every run ends with a user-facing message and a recorded exit reason | 46 | 0 |
| I11 | Every run has a contiguous trace and model calls carry token counts | 46 | 0 |
